0022600145.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-4, on a four-game losing streak and 3 games back in the Pacific) visit the New Orleans Pelicans (0-3, on a three-game losing streak and 3.5 games back in the Southwest), with both teams still searching for their first win. Sacramento will be without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle; 7.0 points and 27.2 minutes per game this season), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), while New Orleans will be without Yves Missi (knee bruise). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, but the Kings lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2, and their most recent meeting was a 117-113 Sacramento win on April 3, 2026.
